newsitem.title: UK: Psion says trade affected by stg, slow sales.
newsitem.headline: Psion says trade affected by stg, slow sales.

text.p: British hand-held computers firm Psion Plc said on Monday that owing to the strength of sterling and a slowdown in sales, the group's performance will be affected until its new Series 5 handheld computer becomes established.
Customer awareness that its Series 5 was soon to be launched "resulted in a slowdown in sales of the Series 3 in May and June, and Siena sales are disappointing," the company said in a statement.
"In these circumstances, the performance of the group will be affected until the Series 5 becomes established in its markets," it added.
At the same time the company announced the launch of its Series 5 model, a new 32-bit computer which "provides laptop-style power, functionality and speed, in a handheld form".
